numbering: TV episodes numbered continuously 1–85 across all four seasons; the Dumpster Battle film has no episode numbers.

arcs.name: Karasuno's Revival and the Inter-High
arcs.summary: Short but explosive Shoyo Hinata joins Karasuno High's fallen volleyball club, only to find his middle-school rival, the genius setter Tobio Kageyama, on the same team.
events: Hinata and Kageyama develop their lightning-fast 'freak quick' attack.
Karasuno plays practice matches against Aoba Johsai and its old rival Nekoma.
Karasuno loses to Aoba Johsai in the Inter-High prefectural tournament.

arcs.name: Tokyo Training Camp and Spring High Qualifiers
arcs.summary: Karasuno joins a summer training camp with strong Tokyo schools, then enters the Spring High qualifiers.
events: Hinata and Kageyama clash over changing their quick attack.
Karasuno gets revenge on Aoba Johsai in the prefectural semifinal.
Karasuno reaches the final against powerhouse Shiratorizawa.

arcs.name: Karasuno vs. Shiratorizawa
arcs.summary: The whole season is one five-set final for a ticket to the national Spring High tournament.
events: Tsukishima blocks ace Ushijima and finally falls in love with volleyball.
Karasuno beats Shiratorizawa to earn a trip to nationals.

arcs.name: To the Top: Training Camps and Nationals Begin
arcs.summary: Before nationals, Kageyama is invited to an all-Japan youth camp while Hinata, left out, sneaks into a rookie camp.
events: Hinata works as a ball boy at Shiratorizawa's camp to learn by watching.
Karasuno opens the Spring High at Tokyo with a win over Tsubakihara.

arcs.name: To the Top: Inarizaki
arcs.summary: Karasuno faces Inarizaki, a top-seeded team led by the Miya twins.
events: Atsumu and Osamu Miya copy Karasuno's freak quick.
Karasuno beats Inarizaki in a tight third set.

arcs.name: The Dumpster Battle
arcs.summary: Karasuno finally meets Nekoma in an official match at nationals, the 'Battle at the Garbage Dump' the two schools have chased for years.
events: Kenma Kozume sets out to stop Hinata by shutting down his movement.
Hinata pushes through the pressure, and Kenma admits volleyball was fun.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga (OVAs sit outside the numbering).
